utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, the repair drive. I’m happy to help out, just remind me what still needs doing and I’ll jump in.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Oren. I’ll check the list and let you know the next piece that still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Rey. I’ll be ready when you’ve got the next task for me.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. I might’ve missed a bit, but I’m in if you need me to help.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, Noah — I’ll keep you in the loop and repeat the plan when it’s set. We’re still sorting the repair drive details, but I’m glad you’re in.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Vik — just let me know when you’ve got the plan sorted, and I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How’s the repair drive going, Uli—do you still need any help?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m still sorting through a few things, but I appreciate you asking. If you have a little time, I could really use help with the drive list.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure—send me the drive list and I’ll help sort it out. What needs fixing first?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and invite folks to come by.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great — thanks, Quinn. Let me know if you want the drive location or hours so you can pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yes, please — send me the location and hours, and I’ll pass them along right away.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hi Hana — happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Sam — I’m checking the details first. Can you tell me what kind of help you can offer for the repair drive and when you’d be available?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with lifting, simple repairs, organizing supplies, or running errands, and I’m usually free evenings after 5 or this Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good—what’s the next thing you need from the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’d love one more pair of hands for the sorting table, and if anyone can bring packing tape, that’d be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help at the sorting table, and I’ll bring packing tape too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks for checking in, Bo — I’m keeping the repair drive organized and warm for everyone. Let’s make sure we’ve got the right list and timing so folks can count on us.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I’ll skim the list and timing now, Rosa — just send me the latest details and I’ll help keep it straight.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Bo — I’ll send the latest list and timing right over, and then we can line up any gaps together.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m in, but let’s pin down the timing and who’s bringing what so we don’t end up scrambling.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good idea. Let’s say Saturday at 10, and I can bring the tools and extension cords—would you handle the checklist and the first-aid kit?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, I can do that. I’ll make the checklist and bring the first-aid kit, and I’ll send you a quick rundown so we’re set.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh good, I’m glad the repair drive is moving along. I’ll keep an ear out for any updates while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Ira — I’m probably the last to hear things, so I really appreciate it. If you catch any news, just pass it along when you can.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely — I’ll keep an eye out and let you know if I hear anything useful. Hope the drive keeps picking up support.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what supplies we’ve got set aside for the repair drive and let you know what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm that and let me know exactly what’s still needed?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll check our set-aside supplies and confirm exactly what’s still needed for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Jules — I can lend a hand or a tool for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need most.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Gus — that’s a huge help. I’ll let you know what we’re short on first, and I’ll keep you posted.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Jules — I’ll keep an eye out and be ready when you need me.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help work around school pickup and drop-off times—what window are you hoping for with the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s really kind of you, Faye—mid-morning would be perfect if we can swing it, maybe 9:30 to 11:30? I’m trying to keep it friendly for folks juggling the school run.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That window should work well for me—I can aim for after drop-off and before pickup. I’ll help spread the word so folks know 9:30 to 11:30 is the sweet spot.
